title: B8.4 author grade (NOT a reference grade)
description: The author's own grade for one submission on its rubric. It is NOT a reference grade: PRD B8.4 asks for reference grades from at least one mentor, and the guide (issue #186, 23 Nov 2026) said the author's grades may stay in the set only when labelled 'author-graded, not reference grades'. The label is part of the document: graded_by is 'author', reference_grade is false, and a mentor_ref is refused, so an author grade can never pass as a mentor grade. Score granularity (Q25) and the band (Q44) are open, so scores are plain non-negative numbers.

graded_by.description: The author of the submission (Student 3). Never a mentor.

reference_grade.description: Always false: this is not a reference grade.

blind_to_drafts.description: Whether the author graded before seeing any AI draft (design section 11.3 proposal).
